decision.reason: [ev-5983baf3dd9a] is a troubleshooting entry in the 0.16 promotion guide. It names an error symptom (the conversion webhook for external-secrets.io/v1 ExternalSecret fails with "could not find the requested resource") and gives a root cause (the CRD installation process failed), but it does not say what changed between 0.15 and 0.16. The rendered diffs ([ev-7a082965d61c], [ev-1265a0fa1fc4] and the other CRD diffs) show spec.conversion (Webhook strategy) being removed from every CRD, but no shown text links that removal to this error. Linking them would be a guess. To write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need source text that says which release change produces this error and who is exposed.
